list_attack_logs.name: Query Attack Logs
list_attack_logs.description: Query WAF attack logs with filters for time range, attack type, and severity

get_log_stats.name: Get Attack Statistics
get_log_stats.description: Get attack log statistics including attack type distribution and source IP ranking

create_micro_rule.name: Create Rule
create_micro_rule.description: Create a new MicroRule for custom access control

fields.name: Rule name
fields.priority: Priority level (100-1000, higher number means higher priority)
fields.condition: Rule condition object containing match_type and patterns

list_blocked_ips.name: List Blocked IPs
list_blocked_ips.description: List all blocked IP addresses and block reasons

get_qps_data.name: Get QPS Data
get_qps_data.description: Get real-time QPS (Queries Per Second) data

fields.limit: Number of data points to return (default: 30, max: 60)

batch_block_ips.name: Batch Block IPs
batch_block_ips.description: Block multiple IP addresses at once

fields.ips: List of IP addresses to block
fields.force: Force block even if already blocked (default: false)

fields.rule_ids: List of rule IDs to update
fields.rollback: Whether to rollback on failure (default: false)

fields.date_range: Date range: last_7d, last_30d, last_90d, custom
fields.export_format: Export format: pdf, html, json (default: json)

predict_threats.name: Threat Prediction
predict_threats.description: Predict potential security threats using AI analysis

fields.threat_types: Threat types to analyze (empty = all types)

auto_respond_threat.name: Auto-Respond to Threat
auto_respond_threat.description: Automatically respond to detected threat patterns

fields.action: Response action: auto, propose, manual (default: propose)
fields.severity_threshold: Severity threshold: critical, high, medium, low (default: high)
fields.scope: Response scope: conservative, moderate, aggressive (default: moderate)

compliance_check.name: Compliance Check
compliance_check.description: Check WAF configuration compliance against security standards

fields.standards: Compliance standards to check: OWASP_TOP_10, PCI_DSS_3.2.1, ISO_27001, NIST_CSF

analyze_traffic_baseline.name: Analyze Traffic Baseline
analyze_traffic_baseline.description: Establish normal traffic baseline patterns for anomaly detection

fields.granularity: Data granularity: hourly, daily, weekly (default: hourly)
